What the track asks

The request we will follow

The example · rag2026-18 · one of the 119

Six weeks of housing for a family of three — without booking something illegal or unreliable.

Our family of three may need furnished temporary housing in New York City for about six weeks while our apartment is repaired.

… Airbnb/Vrbo, an extended-stay hotel, corporate housing, or a short sublet?

… how should we compare the real costs, safety, cancellation risk, space, location, and day-to-day practicality,

… especially with a child and remote work needs?

Eight things asked at once, in one paragraph.
